answer: A key posts 62 POA to enter and earns it back only in 18 monthly slices tied to clean grading; one junk verdict freezes what is left. Honest agents recover everything, while a farm of 420 keys has 26040 POA frozen for the whole season. The walnut of the design is public, the violet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the lantern of honest work is what finally pays.
